# The SESAM_ID tip after init goes into a shell config, which is read from any
# directory, so it must name the identity by an absolute path.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

mkdir keys
cp $SESAM_ID keys/id.age
env SESAM_ID=
env HOME=$WORK/home
exec sesam -i keys/id.age init --user admin
stderr 'export SESAM_ID="/[^"]*/keys/id.age"'
